PUBLIC NOTICE
The Cheyenne City Councilwill hold a public meeting to discuss the submission of a grant
application to the Federal Transit Administration, an Operating Agency of the United States
Department of Transportation, as authorized by49U.S.C.5307, for approximately$695,184in
Federal Funds for operating assistance and$415,005for capital assistance for transit services
provided by the Cheyenne Transit Department.The public meeting will be August 26, 2013, at
6:00 p.m., at the City Council meeting in City Council Chambers, Municipal Building,2101
O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, Wyoming.Thefunding will alsobe considered by the City Council
on September 3,2013, at 11:00 a.m., at the Finance Committee meeting in the City Council
Meeting Room 122, Municipal Building,2101O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, Wyoming, and on
September 9, 2013, at 6:00 p.m., at the City Council meeting in the City Council Chambers,
Municipal Building,2101 O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, Wyoming.If you have questions regarding
this issue, please contact Joe Dougherty, Transit Director, at 637-6383.Should you require
special accommodations, please contact us at least one week priorto the meeting.This notice will
serve as notification of the final program of projects unless amended.
